{{Quote|Best place to buy. Durable, military-grade supplies.|Portani attempts to attract a customer|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Portani''' was a [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned, blue-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], in which the Republic fought the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Portani was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in the [[Apalis Coast]] region, where the Republic-allied [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] had an [[House Organa (estate)|estate]]. Portani wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with green markings on it, and distributed [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and equipment to other Republic forces.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Portani appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Equipment Commendations Vendor for Republic players on Alderaan.<ref name="SWTOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Portani was removed from the game along with the rest of the Equipment Commendations Vendors.<ref name="SWTOR" /> Their position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
